flags.headline: Post-earnings de-rating persists; stock still well below pre-print levels
flags.detail: MRVL closed the 9/3 session at $208.60 (+1.11% on the day) -- a small bounce, but still roughly 23% below the $272 pre-earnings high and below the $217 level cited in the screener's own risk framing. The Q2 beat and raised FY2028 revenue guide (~$18B) did not stop the slide; market focus has shifted to underwhelming hyperscaler-partnership detail, with the next scheduled catalyst (an analyst day) not until October.

flags.headline: Prior RED resolves: MARA +10.6% in a broad, macro-driven crypto rally
flags.detail: MARA, COIN (+10.22%), HUT (+9.21%), HOOD (+16.52%), IBIT (+5.83%) and ETHA (+5.32%) all rallied together on 9/3 after Fed Governor Waller signaled support for holding rates steady, easing September-hike odds from ~70% to 50%; Bitcoin jumped 6.8% to $82,200, a 4-month high, with $730M in spot-ETF inflows. No company-specific catalyst for MARA -- this is beta, not a thesis development. The underlying leveraged-BTC-exposure key_risk is structurally unchanged (still worth a standing watch on the downside), but nothing is materializing today, so this resolves to GREEN.

flags.headline: HOOD +16.52%, book's largest single-day mover, on upgrades plus the broad crypto rally
flags.detail: Morgan Stanley upgraded HOOD to Overweight (PT $124->$150) on 9/1; Scotiabank initiated at Sector Outperform ($136 PT); a Deutsche Bank note flagged prediction-market tailwinds for brokerages; and Robinhood Chain (its Ethereum L2) hit a ~$1.7B annualized revenue run-rate this week. Combined with the same crypto/dovish-Fed tailwind lifting MARA/COIN/HUT, this is straightforwardly positive -- no risk implication.
